item.title: Amid the Iran war, the U.S. has pivoted it's geopolitical attention away from Asia
item.description: A decade ago, the U.S. was still in its "pivot to Asia." Today, as conflicts in the Middle East suck up American military resources, analysts say that pivot is over — or never really began.
item.content:encoded: A decade ago, the U.S. was still in its "pivot to Asia." Today, as conflicts in the Middle East suck up American military resources, analysts say that pivot is over — or never really began.
item.dc:creator: Emily Feng

item.title: Why does the U.S. military seem stymied in the war with Iran?
item.description: Defense analyst Stacie Pettyjohn says while the U.S. military is facing long-range missile shortages, prolonged deployments and vacated regional bases, Iran is building cheaper weapons quickly.
item.content:encoded: Defense analyst Stacie Pettyjohn says while the U.S. military is facing long-range missile shortages, prolonged deployments and vacated regional bases, Iran is building cheaper weapons quickly.

item.title: Greetings from Trouville-sur-Mer, a beach town little changed since Monet painted it
item.description: The Normandy beach town of Trouville-sur-Mer is a two-hour train ride from Paris, but feels a world away, with English Channel breezes and the sound of seagulls screeching through the cobbled streets.

item.title: U.S. delays 50% tariff on Canadian imports. And, takeaways from Florida's primaries
item.description: President Trump has announced that the U.S. is delaying a 50% tariff on Canadian imports after reaching a deal. And, how progressive Democrats fared in Florida's primary elections yesterday.

item.title: How India's blocking of a film exposing real-life police abuses backfired
item.description: When Indian authorities scrubbed the biopic of activist Jaswant Singh Khalra, local villagers and activists turned its censorship into a grassroots movement.

item.title: Congo's Ebola outbreak reaches 5,000 cases as it outpaces response efforts
item.description: Government data showed the outbreak had so far recorded 5,021 cases, including 2,378 deaths. The outbreak has infected and killed more people at a greater speed than any other outbreak in history.

item.title: Australia and New Zealand send over 240 firefighters to help battle U.S. wildfires
item.description: A destructive wildfire season is pushing American firefighting resources to their limits. Australia and New Zealand have sent their largest contingent ever to help out.

item.title: Israel strikes an air base in Syria to prevent Turkish troops from deploying
item.description: Israel struck an air base in northwest Syria early Tuesday, saying it aimed to prevent Turkish troops from deploying there. Turkey, which has close ties with the Syrian government and has been providing assistance to Syria's military.

item.description: The 1,200 deportees will include Africans as well as nationals from North America, South America and the Caribbean, with the first batch of 20 expected on Thursday.

item.title: Canadian tariff deadline looms as two sides continue to negotiate
item.description: The U.S. is scheduled to impose more tariffs on Canada, hitting about $20 billion dollars worth of goods, as trade negotiations between the two neighboring countries hit an impasse.
